thesis: The morning pullback thesis is intact. Intraday last 119.945 is inside the 118-120 entry zone (session low 119.8, so the zone was touched), above SMA20 118.85 and the 117.13 swing low, with no new negative fundamental news; the driver is still the 2026-10-20 Q3 beat and raised guidance (revenue +15% YoY, net income +69% YoY, FCF 804M). Reward/risk is 2.5 at the last price (4.1 from the 119 midpoint), but the target needs a break of the 124.62 52-week high, which has been rejected twice. The stock also sits at the 120.69 consensus target in a risk-off tape, so the rating stays Overweight, not Buy. The debate was skipped by session design, not for a weak setup, and news coverage was Yahoo only because Google RSS was rate-limited.
invalidation: A daily close below 117.13 (Nov 6 low and post-earnings consolidation base) invalidates the setup; 116.85 is the hard stop.
